intro: This is Common Area, a shared online plaza where friends study, play and hang out together, with nothing to install.
plaza: Everyone in the plaza is a real player.
study: Sit down with classmates, and every focused minute earns Soo, the game's currency.
gameroom: For a break, the Game Room has tables for Ludo, Colour Cards and Werewolf.
cards: The server is the referee: it deals, checks every move and runs the turn clock.
astro: Next door, the Astrology Room turns one birth form into three readings.
astro2: Each is built from your own numbers, stars and planets.
friends: Back in the plaza, click a player to send a friend request.
friends2: Once they accept, you can visit their garden any time, even when they are offline.
visit: This is Lin's garden, and a like pays her a little Soo.
garden: Your Soo pays for an island with crops, fruit trees, animals and a house.
garden2: Plants grow in real time, so there is always a reason to return.
forest: Through the east gate is the Quiet Forest, for fishing and calm study.
end: Common Area: study, play and hang out together.
